thread:
Mira (Support): FYI team — planning a short runtime update to dedicated GPU pools tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Target: kernel optimizations + safer quant paths. Expect a rolling change window ~45m. Need customer-facing status page blurb + email copy. @Emily can you draft? @Jason confirm pin/fallback policy for model variants. :wave:

Emily (Customer Ops): On it. Draft below — please quick review. I can schedule at 02:50 UTC for the page publish and send at 02:55.

statuspage-bot: DRAFT STATUS MESSAGE:

"Planned maintenance: rolling runtime update for dedicated GPU pools — scheduled 03:00 UTC, duration ~45 minutes. Some requests may see transient latency increases; no data loss expected. We will post updates here and notify affected customers via email. Follow-up: https://status.redwood.example/incident/INC-2198"

Emily (Customer Ops): Email subject: "Scheduled runtime update — brief service window (03:00 UTC)"
Email body snippet: "We're performing a rolling runtime update in our dedicated GPU region tomorrow at 03:00 UTC. We expect a short window (~45m) during which latency for model responses may increase. No customer data will be modified. If you have reserved capacity contracts and require a maintenance freeze, reply here and we'll schedule an exception."

Jason (Eng Releases): Quick notes on pinning: we'll pin production routes to model-runtime v1.3.2 during the rollout. Automatic fallback -> model-runtime v1.2.9. Fallback triggers: sustained p99 latency > 300ms for 15m OR error rate > 2% across a 10m sliding window. If deploybot sees those conditions, it will pause and notify oncall.

deploybot: Scheduled release job #rel-2198 created by @jason. Staging smoke run queued at 02:30 UTC. Canary strategy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m with manual hold between steps.

Oliver (Oncall): Additions to rollback plan:
- Immediate rollback if 2 consecutive canary slices hit the fallback triggers above.
- If rollback happens, notify customers via status page update and email with timestamp and affected model names.
- Postmortem owner: Jason.

Mira (Support): Emily — please include the pinned version mention and fallback triggers in the customer-facing note? We should avoid deep technical detail but be transparent about the possibility of temporary increased latency and that we'll revert if any elevated errors occur.

Emily (Customer Ops): Done. Updated status message draft to include: "We will revert to the previous runtime if any sustained errors or latency regressions occur." Also added an opt-out line for enterprise customers.

Jason (Eng Releases): Confirming canary plan and pin. I'll push the canary targets to deploybot at 02:45 and monitor traces. Adding a short release note for docs: "Runtime v1.3.2: kernel micro-optimizations, improved quant path stability. Rollout 03:00 UTC. Pinned routes during rollout. Fallback to v1.2.9 on regressions."

Mira (Support): Approve. Emily — go ahead and publish status page at 02:50 and send email at 02:55. Tag @sales-team and @account-managers with the enterprise opt-outs list. :white_check_mark:

statuspage-bot: Status page update scheduled at 02:50 UTC.

deploybot: Canary will start at 03:00 UTC. Monitoring hooks: traces.redwood.internal/canary/rel-2198 and alerts to pager.

Oliver (Oncall): I'll be on-call for the window. If we hit fallback triggers, I'll coordinate rollback and customer notifications.

Mira (Support): Thanks all — logging final comms here for audit and handoff. If anything changes, update this thread.

Emily (Customer Ops): Published and sent. Posting final status link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/INC-2198/updates/1
